name: Zip mover intangibility: after a jump off a zip mover it isn't a wall for 8 ticks
techNote: Anchored on Course 5 overgrown's zip mover (Course 15's world, trace start-c15-wjdsdjbszip.json; the 256x320 ZipMoverMovingPart at world (-3774.5, -664.3), the lab's (0, 0)): the lab adds only a floor right of it (x 158-560, flush with the ledge under the zip). Walk left into the zip's right face (tick 17: the touch starts its move, (-460, +300) over 0.6 s) and jump on input 18 while touching it: Movement.MovingPlatformMomentumInherit calls PlatformMover.MakeIntangible, the block is on the Default layer for 0.15 s. Dash left on input 21: the wall rays (Ground only) miss the block, so the dash isn't stopped as a wall: it runs 5 ticks against the face at y -73.6 (only the hurtbox collides) and clings on tick 26, the 8th tick after the jump, when the block is Ground again; the zip then carries the cling up-left into the finish box at its end (tick 50). `no-touch` (the same jump and dash from 40 u further right: the jump is before the touch, no intangibility) clings on the dash's first tick. At 1x the block can come back a tick later (the tech's note).

ghosts.label: Jump touching the zip, dash into it: no cling for 8 ticks
The jump before touching it: the dash clings at once
